title: מלכת דרקון הקרח
summary: הסטרימרית קמה, מזמנת דרקון קרח לבן ענק מאחוריה, מתכסה בשריון קשקשי כסף ויורה אנרגיה כחולה בזמן שהדרקון נושף קרח.

phases.what: Eyes glow bright blue while sitting, then she stands up and steps back.
Swings arm creating a blue energy trail and a frost puddle on the floor.
Giant white ice dragon appears behind her; silver scales and blue frost spread over her clothes.
Reaches hand forward with glowing blue energy as the dragon leans in and breathes a blast of blue ice.

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and their eyes suddenly glow bright ice-blue. Keep the person recognizable throughout. They stand up from their chair, step back, and sweep their arm in an arc, leaving a glowing blue energy trail while a white frost puddle spreads under their feet. A massive white spiky ice dragon with glowing blue eyes materializes behind them as silver dragon-scale armor and glowing blue frost spread across their clothes and arms. They extend a glowing blue ice-covered hand toward the camera as the giant dragon leans forward and unleashes a bright blue blast of icy breath. Cinematic blue lighting, high contrast, vertical framing.
